recognize_zh: 低倍的周邊血抹片中，白血球多為中型、細胞質少、無顆粒的芽細胞，成熟中性球很少；芽細胞無顆粒亦無 Auer 小體，形態上無法分辨系別，需流式細胞儀才能確認為 AML 微分化型。
features: Increased circulating medium-sized mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio (blasts)
Round to slightly irregular nuclei; chromatin detail limited at this low magnification
Scant, agranular pale blue cytoplasm without visible Auer rods
Rare mature neutrophil; red cells appear normocytic
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows increased circulating medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant, agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Mature neutrophils are rare and platelets appear decreased. Chromatin and nucleolar details cannot be adequately assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; because blasts in AML with minimal differentiation lack morphologic and cytochemical evidence of myeloid differentiation, lineage assignment requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts look similar but express B- or T-lineage antigens (CD19, CD79a, cyCD3) instead of myeloid markers such as CD13, CD33 and CD117.
MPAL blasts express lineage-defining markers of more than one lineage by flow cytometry, which morphology cannot detect.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm and mature chromatin, not the high N:C ratio of blasts.
